description: Source code implementing buffer size level definitions, decoding Long Buffer Status Reports (LBSR), and converting buffer size fields to bytes for 3GPP 5G NR MAC layer.

methods.name: decode_lbsr
methods.description: Decodes a Long Buffer Status Report (LBSR) from payload based on BSR format, returning a structured report.

methods.name: buff_size_field_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts buffer size field index to actual byte size based on BSR format.
